question: What did Yahweh say would happen to the nation that enslaved Abram’s offspring?
answer: Yahweh said that he would judge that nation.

question: How did Yahweh say Abram’s life would end?
answer: Yahweh said that Abram would die in peace at a good old age.

question: What would reach its limit before Abram’s offspring returned to the land promised them?
answer: The sin of the Amorites would reach its limit before Abram’s offspring returned.

question: That night, what happened amongst the pieces of the animals Abram had prepared?
answer: A smoking fire pot and flaming torch passed between the pieces of the animals.

question: What covenant did Yahweh make with Abram that day?
answer: Yahweh made a covenant with Abram that he would give this land to Abram’s offspring.

question: What idea did Sarai have for giving Abram a descendant?
answer: Sarai told Abram to sleep with her servant, Hagar, in order to have children by her.

question: What happened between Hagar and Sarai when Hagar conceived a child with Abram?
answer: After Hagar conceived, Hagar looked on Sarai with disrespect.

question: What complaint did Sarai bring to Abram, and how did Abram respond?
answer: Sarai complained that it was Abram’s fault that Hagar despised her, and Abram told Sarai to do what she thought best with Hagar.

question: How did Sarai treat Hagar after Hagar conceived, and what did Hagar do?
answer: Sarai treated Hagar harshly, and Hagar fled.

question: In the wilderness, what did the angel of Yahweh tell Hagar to do?
answer: The angel of Yahweh told Hagar to return to Sarai and submit to her authority.

question: What promise did the angel of Yahweh make to Hagar?
answer: The angel of Yahweh promised Hagar that her offspring would be too numerous to count.

question: Why was Hagar told to name her son Ishmael?
answer: Hagar was told to name her son Ishmael, because Yahweh had heard her affliction.

question: How will Ishmael treat other people?
answer: Ishmael will be hostile against every man, and will live apart from all his brothers.

question: What name did Hagar give Yahweh?
answer: Hagar gave Yahweh the name, “The God who sees me.”

question: How old was Abram when Ishmael was born?
answer: Abram was eighty-six years old when Ishmael was born.

question: How old was Abram when Yahweh appeared again to him to confirm his covenant with Abram?
answer: Abram was ninety-nine years old when Yahweh again appeared to Abram.

question: What command did Yahweh give Abram concerning Abram’s way of life?
answer: Yahweh commanded Abram to walk before him blamelessly.

question: To what did Yahweh change Abram’s name, and what does the name mean?
answer: Yahweh changed Abram’s name to Abraham, which means “father of a multitude of nations.”

question: What did Yahweh give to Abraham’s offspring as part of the covenant?
answer: Yahweh gave Abraham’s offspring all the land of Canaan as part of the covenant.

question: What did Yahweh say would be the relationship between Abraham’s offspring and Yahweh?
answer: Yahweh said that he would be God to Abraham’s offspring.

question: What did Yahweh command be done as a sign of the covenant between Abraham and Yahweh?

question: What was to be done with foreigners who joined a household that was in covenant with Yahweh?
answer: Foreigners who joined a household in covenant with Yahweh were also to be circumcised.

question: At what age was a baby to be circumcised?
answer: A baby was to be circumcised after eight days.

question: What happened to any male who was not circumcised?
answer: Any male who was not circumcised was cut off from his people because he had broken the covenant.

question: To what did Yahweh change Sarai’s name?
answer: Yahweh changed Sarai’s name to Sarah.

question: What did Yahweh promise would come by Sarah?
answer: Yahweh promised that Abraham’s son would come by Sarah.

question: How did Abraham respond to Yahweh’s promise concerning Sarah?
answer: Abraham laughed and asked how a child could be born to a man and woman who were so old.

question: What did God say Abraham must name the son that would come by Sarah?
answer: God said that Abraham must name the son Isaac.

question: What did God say he would establish with Isaac?
answer: God said that he would establish his covenant with Isaac.

question: What promise did God make concerning Ishmael?
answer: God promised to bless Ishmael, to make him fruitful, and to make him a great nation.

question: What did God say he would establish with Isaac?
answer: God said that he would establish his covenant with Isaac.

question: After God left Abraham, what did Abraham do on that same day?
answer: On that same day, Abraham circumcised all the males of his household.

question: How old was Ishmael when he was circumcised?
answer: Ishmael was thirteen years old when he was circumcised.

question: As Abraham was sitting at his tent door, what did he see when he looked up?
answer: Abraham saw three men standing nearby him.

question: What did Abraham offer the men?
answer: Abraham offered the men some water to wash their feet, and he offered some food.

question: Where was Sarah when the visitor gave his prediction?
answer: Sarah was in the tent.

question: What prediction did the one visitor give concerning Sarah?
answer: The one visitor said that when he returned, Sarah would have a son.

question: How did Sarah respond to the visitor’s prediction?
answer: Sarah laughed to herself when she heard the visitor’s prediction.

question: What did Yahweh, the visitor, say about Sarah’s response?
answer: Yahweh asked why Sarah laughed, and said “Is anything too hard for Yahweh?”

question: When the men got up, toward where did they look?
answer: The men looked toward Sodom.

question: What question did Yahweh ask as they walked?
answer: Yahweh said, “Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing?”

question: What did Yahweh say Abraham must do so that Yahweh might fulfill the promises given to Abraham?
answer: Yahweh said that Abraham must instruct his children and his household to do righteousness and justice.

question: Why were the men going toward Sodom?
answer: The men were going toward Sodom because the outcry against Sodom and Gomorrah was great, and they wanted to see if the cities were as wicked as the outcry suggested.

question: As Abraham stood with Yahweh, what question did he ask Yahweh?
answer: Abraham asked, “Will you sweep away the righteous with the wicked?”

question: What did Yahweh say he would do if there were fifty righteous within the city?
answer: Yahweh said he would spare the whole place for their sake.

question: What did Yahweh say he would do if there were forty-five righteous within the city?
answer: Yahweh said he would spare the whole place for their sake.

question: What did Yahweh say he would do if there were forty righteous within the city?
answer: Yahweh said he would spare the whole place for their sake.

question: What did Yahweh say he would do if there were thirty righteous within the city?
answer: Yahweh said he would spare the whole place for their sake.

question: What did Yahweh say he would do if there were twenty righteous within the city?
answer: Yahweh said he would spare the whole place for their sake.

question: What did Yahweh say he would do if there were ten righteous within the city?
answer: Yahweh said he would spare the whole place for their sake.

question: When Lot saw the two angels coming into Sodom, what did he offer to them?
answer: Lot offered that they stay at his home for the night and then leave in the morning.

question: What was the angels’ response to Lot?
answer: The angels said that they would spend the night in the street.

question: At Lot’s strong urging, where did the angels finally decide to spend the night?
answer: Finally, the angels went with Lot to his home for the night.

question: What did the men of the city who surrounded Lot’s house want Lot to do?
answer: The men wanted Lot to bring out the two men who were visiting him, so they could know then carnally.

question: What did Lot offer the men of the city instead?
answer: Lot offered the men of the city his two daughters instead of the two visitors.

question: How did the men respond to Lot’s offer?
answer: The men told Lot to stand back, and they almost broke down the door.

question: What did the angels then do?
answer: The angels pulled Lot back into the house and struck the men outside with blindness.

question: What did the angels say they had been sent to do by Yahweh?
answer: The angels said they had been sent to destroy the city.

question: How did Lot’s sons-in-law respond when Lot told them to hurry and leave Sodom because it was about to be destroyed?
answer: Lot’s sons-in-law thought Lot was joking.

question: When morning dawned, what did the angels tell Lot to do?
answer: The angels told Lot to take his wife and daughters and get out of the city so they would not be destroyed too.

question: Why, despite Lot’s lingering, did the angels bring Lot and his family by their hands out of the city?
answer: The angels set them outside the city because Yahweh was merciful to them.

question: What instructions did the angels give Lot when they were outside the city?
answer: The angels told Lot and his family to flee for their lives and to not look back.

question: Where did the angel allow Lot and his family to flee?
answer: Lot and his family were allowed to flee to a small city called Zoar.

question: What did Yahweh do when Lot reached Zoar?
answer: Yahweh rained down sulfur and fire from the sky on Sodom and Gomorrah.

question: What did Lot’s wife do, and what happened to her?
answer: Lot’s wife looked back, and she became a pillar of salt.

question: What did Abraham see early in the morning as he looked down at all the land of the plain?
answer: Abraham saw smoke rising from the land like the smoke of a furnace.

question: To where did Lot then move and why?
answer: Lot then moved to a cave in the mountains, because he was afraid to live in Zoar.

question: What plan did Lot’s daughters make involving their father?
answer: Lot’s daughters planned to make their father drunk, then lie with him so that they could have children.

question: Which two people groups came from the daughters of Lot?
answer: The Moabite and Ammonite people groups came from the daughters of Lot.

question: What did Abraham say about Sarah while he was living at Gerar?
answer: Abraham said that Sarah was his sister.

question: What did God say to Abimelech after he took Sarah?

question: What did Abimelech tell God that he had been told by Abraham and Sarah?

question: What did God tell Abimelech to do, and what did God say would happen if he did not do it?

question: How did Abimelech’s men respond when they heard what God had told Abimelech?
answer: Abimelech’s men were very afraid when they heard what God had told him.

question: Why did Abraham say he had told Abimelech that Sarah was his sister?
answer: Abraham said that he was afraid Abimelech would kill him because of Sarah.

question: In what way was Sarah actually Abraham’s sister?
answer: Sarah was the daughter of Abraham’s father but not of his mother.

question: What gift did Abimelech give Abraham?
answer: Abimelech gave Abraham 1,000 {shekels of} silver.

question: What reason did Abimelech give Sarah as to why he gave her brother a thousand pieces of silver?
answer: Abimelech told Sarah he had given a thousand pieces of silver to her brother to cover any offense against Sarah in the eyes of all that were with Sarah, so that she was vindicated.

question: What happened when Abraham prayed to God for Abimelech and his people?
answer: God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female slaves so that they were able to have children.

question: What did Yahweh do for Sarah?
answer: Yahweh visited Sarah, and she bore a son to Abraham at the promised time.

question: When Isaac was eight days old, what did Abraham do?
answer: When Isaac was eight days old, Abraham circumcised him.

question: What did Sarah say God had made her do?
answer: Sarah said that God had made her laugh.

question: On the day Isaac was weaned, what did Sarah see?
answer: Sarah saw that the son of Hagar was mocking.

question: What did Sarah tell Abraham to do with Hagar and her son, and why?
answer: Sarah told Abraham to drive away Hagar and her son, because Hagar’s son would not be heir with Isaac.

question: What was Abraham’s reaction to Sarah’s demand?
answer: Abraham was distressed by Sarah’s demand because of his son by Hagar.

question: What did God tell Abraham to do?
answer: God told Abraham to listen to Sarah.

question: Where did Hagar and her son go after Abraham sent them out?
answer: Hagar and her son went into the wilderness.

question: What did God tell Hagar he would do for her son?
answer: God said he would make the son of Hagar into a great nation.

question: How did Hagar and her son survive?
answer: God opened Hagar’s eyes and she saw a well of water.

question: What happened to Hagar’s son as he grew up?
answer: Hagar’s son lived in the wilderness of Paran, and his mother got a wife for him from Egypt.

question: What did Abimelech want Abraham to swear to do for him?
answer: Abimelech wanted Abraham to swear that he would not deal falsely with Abimelech or with his children or with his descendants. Abimelech asked Abraham to show to him the same covenant faithfulness that Abimelech had shown to Abraham.

question: What did Abraham complain about to Abimelech?
answer: Abraham complained to Abimelech about a well of water that Abimelech’s servants had seized from him.

question: Why did Abraham give seven female lambs to Abimelech?
answer: Abraham gave seven female lambs to Abimelech as a witness that he had dug the disputed well.

question: Into what land did Abimelech return?
answer: Abimelech returned into the land of the Philistines.

question: What did Abraham do at the tamarisk tree in Beersheba?
answer: Abraham worshiped Yahweh, the eternal God.

question: Where did Abraham live for many days?
answer: Abraham lived in the land of the Philistines for many days.

question: What test did God give Abraham?
answer: God told Abraham to go the land of Moriah and offer Isaac as a burnt offering.

question: How did Abraham respond to God’s command?
answer: Abraham rose early in the morning and set out on his journey to the place God had told him.

question: What did Abraham tell his two young men that he and Isaac were going to do?
answer: Abraham told his two young men that he and Isaac were going to worship and then would return.

question: What question did Isaac ask Abraham as they were walking together?
answer: Isaac asked Abraham, “Where is the lamb for the burnt offering?”

question: How did Abraham answer Isaac’s question?
answer: Abraham said that God himself would provide the lamb for the burnt offering.

question: When they reached the place, what did Abraham prepare as the burnt offering and how did he do it?
answer: Abraham prepared Isaac as the burnt offering by binding him and laying him on the altar.

question: When Abraham took the knife in his hand, what did the angel of Yahweh tell Abraham?
answer: The angel of Yahweh told Abraham not to harm Isaac.

question: What did the angel say that he now knew about Abraham?
answer: The angel said that he now knew that Abraham feared God.

question: How did God then provide the burnt offering for Abraham?
answer: There was a ram caught in the bushes behind Abraham: Abraham used it as the burnt offering.

question: What did Abraham call the place of the burnt offering?
answer: Abraham called the place Yahweh-Yireh, which means “Yahweh will provide”.

question: What reason did the angel of Yahweh give for blessing Abraham?
answer: The angel of Yahweh said he would bless Abraham because Abraham had not withheld his only son.

question: Through whom and for what reason were all nations of the earth to be blessed?
answer: All the nations of the earth were to be blessed through Abraham’s offspring because Abraham had obeyed Yahweh’s command delivered by his angel.

question: What did Abraham first do when Sarah died?
answer: When Sarah died, Abraham first mourned for her and wept for her.

question: What request did Abraham make to the sons of Heth?
answer: Abraham asked for a property to use as a burial place.

question: How did the sons of Heth respond to Abraham’s request?
answer: The sons of Heth offered the choicest of their tombs to Abraham.

question: When Abraham asked for Ephron the Hittite’s cave as a tomb, how did Ephron respond?
answer: Ephron offered to freely give Abraham the cave and the field next to it.

question: How did Abraham respond to Ephron’s offer?
answer: Abraham asked to pay for the field and the cave.

question: How did the conversation between Abraham and Ephron end?
answer: Abraham paid 400 shekels of silver to Ephron for the piece of land.

question: How did Ephron respond to Abraham’s offer?
answer: Ephron asked for 400 shekels of silver for the field and the cave.

question: What was included in the purchase of the field of Ephron which was in Machpelah?
answer: The field, the cave that was in it, and all the trees that were in the field and all around its border were included in Abraham’s purchase of the field of Ephron.

question: What did Abraham then do with the cave?
answer: Abraham then buried Sarah in the cave.

question: What did Abraham make his oldest servant swear to do?
answer: Abraham made his oldest servant swear that he would get a wife for Isaac from Abraham’s relatives.

question: What did Abraham insist that the servant not do with Isaac?
answer: Abraham insisted that the servant not take Isaac back to the land from which Abraham came.

question: What did Abraham’s servant ask God to do in order to show him which woman God had chosen for Isaac?
answer: The servant asked that the woman whom he asked to lower her pitcher to let him get a drink would do so and offer to water his camels also.

question: What relation was Rebekah to Abraham?
answer: Rebekah was the granddaughter of Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

question: What did Rebekah do when Abraham’s servant asked for a drink of water?
answer: Rebekah gave the servant a drink.

question: What did Rebekah say after she had finished giving the servant a drink?
answer: After Rebekah finished giving the servant a drink, she said, “I will draw water for your camels also, until they have finished drinking.”

question: What did the servant do when he heard that Rebekah was related to Abraham and that he could spend the night with her family?
answer: The servant worshiped Yahweh and blessed him.

question: Who was Rebekah’s brother?
answer: Laban was Rebekah’s brother.

question: What did Laban do when he met Abraham’s servant?
answer: Laban invited Abraham’s servant to stay at his house.

question: What did Abraham’s servant insist on doing before he ate?
answer: Abraham’s servant insisted on saying why he had come before he ate.

question: How had Abraham said that Yahweh would prosper the servant’s way?
answer: Abraham had said that Yahweh would send his angel with the servant to prosper his way.

question: What had the servant given Rebekah when he heard she was related to Abraham?
answer: Abraham’s servant had given Rebekah a gold ring for her nose and bracelets for her arms.

question: How did Laban and Bethuel answer Abraham’s servant when he asked them what they wanted to do regarding Rebekah?
answer: Laban and Bethuel answered that the servant should take Rebekah and go, so that Rebekah could be the wife of Abraham’s son.

question: What did Abraham’s servant do when he heard the answer from Laban and Bethuel?
answer: The servant bowed down to Yahweh. And then he gave gifts to Rebekah and to her brother and mother.

question: When they arose the next morning, what did Rebekah’s brother and mother want the servant to do?
answer: When they arose the next morning, they wanted Abraham’s servant to stay with them for a few more days.

question: When Abraham’s servant said that he wanted to go immediately, what did Rebekah say that she wanted to do?
answer: Rebekah said that she wanted to go with the servant.

question: What blessing did Rebekah’s family give her as she left with Abraham’s servant?
answer: Rebekah’s family blessed her that she might be the mother of thousands and that her offspring might possess the gate of those who hate them.

question: What was Isaac doing when Rebekah arrived at his home?
answer: Isaac was out in the field meditating.

question: What did Rebekah do when she saw Isaac?
answer: When she saw Isaac, Rebekah jumped down from the camel and covered herself with her veil.

question: What did Isaac do after Abraham’s servant recounted all the things that he had done?
answer: Isaac brought Rebekah into his mother Sarah’s tent and took Rebekah as his wife.

question: What did Abraham do after his wife Sarah died?
answer: Abraham took another wife named Keturah.

question: How did Abraham distribute his wealth?
answer: Abraham gave gifts to the sons of his concubines and sent them away. He left all that he owned to Isaac.

question: How many years did Abraham live?
answer: Abraham lived one hundred seventy-five years.

question: Who buried Abraham?
answer: Both Isaac and Ishmael buried Abraham.

question: What did Isaac do because Rebekah was childless?
answer: Isaac prayed to Yahweh for his wife; Yahweh answered his prayer, and Rebekah conceived.

question: What did Yahweh say concerning the two children struggling within Rebekah’s womb?
answer: Yahweh said that there were two nations in her womb, one people stronger than the other, and that the older would serve the younger.

question: Who was born first, and what did he look like?
answer: Esau was born first, and he was red all over, like a hairy garment.

question: Who was born second, and what was he doing as he was born?
answer: Jacob was born second, and he was grasping Esau’s heel as he was born.

question: What kind of man was Esau?
answer: Esau was a skillful hunter and a man of the field.

question: What kind of man was Jacob?
answer: Jacob was a quiet man who spent his time in the tents.

question: Who did Isaac love, and who did Rebekah love?
answer: Isaac loved Esau, and Rebekah loved Jacob.

question: What was another name for Esau?
answer: Edom was another name for Esau.

question: For what did Jacob ask in return for the red stew that Esau wanted to eat?
answer: Jacob asked for Esau’s birthright in return for the red stew.

question: What was Esau’s response to Jacob’s offer?
answer: Esau swore an oath and sold his birthright to Jacob.

question: How was Esau treating his birthright when he responded in this way to Jacob’s offer?
answer: Esau was despising his birthright when he responded to Jacob’s offer in this way.

question: Why did Isaac move to the city of Gerar where Abimelech was the king of the Philistines?
answer: Isaac moved to Gerar because there was a famine in the land.

question: What had Yahweh told Isaac before Isaac moved to Gerar?
answer: Yahweh had told Isaac not to move to Egypt, and to stay in the land about which he would tell Isaac.

question: What did Yahweh tell Isaac about the oath Yahweh had sworn to his father Abraham?
answer: Yahweh told Isaac that he would fulfill the oath which Yahweh had sworn to Abraham.

question: Why did Yahweh say he was going to do this?
answer: Yahweh said he was going to do this because Abraham had obeyed his voice and kept his instructions, commandments, statutes, and laws.

question: What did Isaac say to the men of Gerar about Rebekah, his wife?
answer: Isaac told the men of Gerar that Rebekah was his sister.

question: According to Abimelech, what could have brought guilt upon the people because of Isaac’s lie?
answer: Because of Isaac’s lie, someone could have had sexual relations with Rebekah and brought guilt upon the people.

question: What command did Abimelech give regarding Rebekah?

question: What reason did Abimelech give for asking Isaac to move away from the Philistines?

question: Why did Isaac have to dig out the wells of water which they had dug in the days of Abraham?

question: What did Isaac name the well over which the herdsmen of Gerar did not quarrel with him?

question: What did Yahweh reaffirm to Isaac when he appeared to Isaac at Beersheba?

question: What covenant did Abimelech want to make with Isaac, and why?

question: How did Isaac respond to Abimelech’s request for a covenant between them?

question: From what people group were the two wives of Esau?

question: How was the relationship between Esau’s wives and Isaac and Rebekah?
answer: Esau’s wives brought grief to Isaac and Rebekah.

question: As Isaac grew old, what was he no longer able to do?

question: What did Isaac ask Esau to do, and why?

question: What was Rebekah’s plan for providing the food for Isaac, and why?

question: About what was Jacob concerned in bringing the food to Isaac?

question: How did Rebekah solve the problem of Esau being a hairy man, and Jacob a smooth man?

question: When Isaac asked, how did Jacob say he had found the game so quickly?
answer: Jacob said that Yahweh, Isaac’s God, had brought the game to him.

question: Because he was not sure, how did Isaac try to determine who was giving him the food?
answer: Isaac touched Jacob on the hands and felt the hairy goatskins.

question: What did Jacob say when Isaac asked, “Are you really my son Esau?”?
answer: Jacob said, “I am.”

question: What finally convinced Isaac that the person bringing the food was Esau?
answer: When Jacob came near Isaac to kiss him, Isaac smelled Esau’s clothes.

question: Who did Isaac say would bow down to Jacob?
answer: Isaac said nations would bow down to Jacob and that Jacob’s mother’s sons would bow down to him.

question: What did Esau do soon after Jacob left Isaac’s tent?
answer: Esau came in from hunting, prepared the food, and brought it to Isaac.

question: What did Isaac say when Esau asked for Isaac’s blessing?
answer: Isaac said that Jacob had deceitfully taken away Esau’s blessing.

question: In what two ways did Esau say Jacob had cheated him?

question: What was the “blessing” that Isaac gave Esau?
answer: Isaac said that Esau would live away from the fatness of the earth, that he would serve his brother, but would eventually rebel against him and break off Jacob’s yoke.

question: What did Esau decide to do after Isaac’s death?
answer: Esau decided to kill Jacob after Isaac’s death.

question: What did Rebekah do after hearing Esau’s plans?

question: What command did Isaac give Jacob before he left?
answer: Isaac commanded Jacob not to take a Canaanite wife.

question: Where did Isaac tell Jacob to get a wife?
answer: Isaac told Jacob to get a wife from the daughters of Laban, Rebekah’s brother.

question: Whose blessing did Isaac ask God to give Jacob?
answer: Isaac asked God to give Jacob the blessing of Abraham.

question: From where did Esau get one of his wives when he saw that the women of Canaan did not please Isaac?
answer: Esau took a wife from the daughters of Ishmael, Abraham’s son.

question: What did Jacob see in his dream while on the way to Haran?
answer: Jacob saw a stairway from earth to heaven with angels ascending and descending on it, and Yahweh standing above it.

question: What did Yahweh say about the land Jacob was lying on?
answer: Yahweh said that the land Jacob was lying on would be given to him and his offspring.

question: Whose blessing did Yahweh give to Jacob?
answer: Yahweh gave Jacob the blessing of Abraham.

question: What did Jacob say about the place where he had the dream?
